name: Serving The Poor
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to generously open their hands to the poor and needy, recognizing that poverty will persist in the land (Deuteronomy 15:11). Honoring God is closely tied to showing mercy to the poor, as oppressing them is equated with reproaching the Creator (Proverbs 14:31). The Bible assures that acts of kindness toward the poor are regarded as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such generosity (Proverbs 19:17). Moreover, giving to the poor brings blessing and provision, while ignoring their needs invites judgment (Proverbs 22:9; 28:27), and actively satisfying the afflicted results in spiritual illumination and favor (Isaiah 58:10).
